text:
:= by
  have h1 : n ^ 2 - 2 * n ≥ 3 := by
    rw [sub_le_sub_iff_right]
    exact (le_add_right (n ^ 2 - 2 * n) 3)
  suffices h2 : n ^ 2 - 2 * n ≥ 3 by exact h2
  calc
    n ^ 2 - 2 * n = n * n - 2 * n
    ...
    n * n - 2 * n = n * (n - 2)
  exact le_mul_of_nonneg_left (n - 2) (le_sub_right_of_add_le (n + 2) 2 hn) (le_add_right n 1)
